check_name: Ensure CloudFront distribution has Access Logging enabled
reason: No visitor request/audit logs; request analysis is unavailable. Data minimization and cost choice; HTTPS smoke verifies sampled delivery only and does not replace logging.

check_name: Ensure CloudFront distributions should have origin failover configured
reason: Single private S3 origin is intentional; no second persistent environment or failover origin.

check_name: Ensure AWS CloudFront web distribution has geo restriction enabled
reason: Public professional portfolio intentionally reachable globally.

check_name: Verify CloudFront Distribution Viewer Certificate is using TLS v1.2 or higher
reason: AWS default CloudFront certificate fixes minimum viewer TLS policy; custom domain/certificate excluded. HTTPS remains mandatory; legacy client TLS residual documented.

check_name: CloudFront Distribution should have WAF enabled
reason: Read-only static assets/no backend; pay-as-you-go WAF exceeds target cost. Free CloudFront flat-rate WAF is a separate unenrolled offering, not this distribution.

check_name: Ensure AWS CloudFront distribution uses custom SSL certificate
reason: Specification requires default CloudFront hostname; no custom certificate/domain.

check_name: Ensure AWS CloudFront attached WAFv2 WebACL is configured with AMR for Log4j Vulnerability
reason: No runtime or Log4j; no WAF inspection/managed rules. Pay-as-you-go WAF cost excluded; separate free flat-rate plan not enrolled. CSP/origin isolation address different risks.

check_name: Ensure S3 buckets should have event notifications enabled
reason: No event-consumer requirement; no event-driven state-change alerting. Native locks control concurrency and are not event monitoring.

check_name: Ensure S3 buckets should have event notifications enabled
reason: No event consumer or event-alert requirement in scope; absent notifications mean no event-driven object-change monitoring.

check_name: Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled
reason: State data-access audit logging is absent. S3 log delivery is free; storage/access costs and additional audit infrastructure omitted. Exact IAM/versioning/locks prevent other risks but do not audit state reads.

check_name: Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled
reason: No S3 access audit log selected for this public static site; log delivery is free but storage/access fees and visitor-data retention remain. Origin blocks prevent bypass but do not provide auditing.

check_name: Ensure that S3 bucket has cross-region replication enabled
reason: Single-region versioned state is not regional disaster recovery. A private operator recovery backup is a release prerequisite, not verified to exist.

check_name: Ensure that S3 bucket has cross-region replication enabled
reason: Single region required; versioned bucket provides recovery without replication cost.

check_name: Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default
reason: SSE-S3 at rest; no independent KMS key-policy boundary. Customer-managed key monthly/request costs excluded; AWS-managed KMS storage itself is free, requests may cost.

check_name: Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default
reason: SSE-S3 provides at-rest encryption without separate key-policy separation. Customer-managed KMS key monthly/request costs excluded; AWS-managed KMS has no key storage charge but request charges may apply.
